proposal_models.name: RoboPEPP
proposal_models.role: occlusion-aware robot keypoint and joint initialization only

proposal_models.name: RoboPose
proposal_models.role: render-and-compare camera-to-robot and articulated pose initialization only

immutable_rules: A foundation model proposes landmarks, masks, or initial q; it cannot promote its own prediction.
Every one of the 73 scalar joints must be present and data-identifiable on every source frame.
Priors on cropped legs or occluded fingers stabilize an optimizer but do not reduce posterior uncertainty.
The selected asset must beat explicit alternative assets on held-out frames.
Joint-state evidence must be sensor measurement, calibrated geometry, or a named physics-solver estimate.
Proposal-model and exact-renderer names and revisions are mandatory.
No trajectory artifact is emitted when any physical or observability gate fails.
